input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 buries both exits inside the auto-renewal sentence, so the Company has at best a non-renewal right and no express convenience right, and nothing confines HDI's exit to the end of a term (the retained "Such notice shall specify the date" sentence otherwise leaves the Termination Date open). We therefore neutralise the party wording in the renewal sentence and add two standalone sentences: the Company may terminate for convenience and without cause on ninety (90) days' notice, and HDI may do so only effective at the end of the then-current term on the same notice. The material fee failure is Section 4.2(a): a Termination Payment of one half of twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000 on any Company termination, uncapped and payable over eight quarters under 4.2(c); we cap it at three months of the Section 3.1 payments. We target the fallback, not preferred: notice stays at 90 days rather than 30 and there is no pro-rata prepaid-fee refund, which we note but do not press. Section 4.2(a)'s bite where the Company terminates for HDI's breach is reserved to a cause/remedies rule.

proposal.summary: Standalone Company convenience right at 90 days; HDI limited to end-of-term exit; Termination Payment capped at three months' fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have moved the termination rights out of the auto-renewal sentence so the Company has a standalone right to terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice, confined HDI's convenience exit to the end of the then-current term on the same notice, and capped the Section 4.2 Termination Payment at three months of Section 3.1 fees rather than an uncapped share of twelve months' Net Sales. This is our fallback position on convenience termination and early-termination fees.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated upon ninety (90) days written notice as provided in this Section 4.1.

ops.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience and without cause upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI. HDI may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term, upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company.
In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the aggregate payments due from the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate for convenience on 60 to 90 days' notice.
Any early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
Vendor may terminate for convenience only at the end of a term.
Vendor must give at least 90 days' notice of convenience termination.
